# Dhruba Power & Engineering

> Authorized industrial electrical, solar, and HT/LT substation engineering provider based in Barishal, Bangladesh. Over 7 years of engineering leadership and 500+ executed infrastructure projects.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Sub-Station Engineering & Commissioning](/services/substation): Turnkey 11kV/0.415kV industrial substation design, transformer supply, vacuum circuit breakers (VCB), and BPDB/BREB utility approvals.
- [Industrial & Commercial Solar Systems](/services/solar-system): High-efficiency on-grid net-metering and hybrid solar plants for factories, commercial roofs, and agricultural facilities.
- [Lightning Protection & Arresters](/services/lightning-arrester): Advanced Early Streamer Emission (ESE) lightning arresters, surge protection devices (SPD), and copper earthing networks compliant with BNBC 2020.
- [Industrial Electrical Wiring & HT/LT Distribution](/services/electrical-wiring): Heavy-duty industrial cable laying, busbar trunking (BBT), and cable ladder installations for textiles and processing plants.
- [CC-TV & Surveillance Systems](/services/cctv-installation): High-definition IP perimeter surveillance, NVR systems, thermal monitoring, and optical fiber backbone integration.
- [Custom HT/LT Switchgear & Panel Boards](/services/panel-board): In-house fabrication of Motor Control Centers (MCC), Power Factor Improvement (PFI) plants, and automatic changeover switch (ATS) panels.

## Product Catalogue

- [Industrial Equipment Catalog](/shop): Faceted search for electrical power, solar, and industrial surveillance components.
- [Electrical & Power Distribution (EEE)](/category/eee): Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCB), Molded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCB), Air Circuit Breakers (ACB), and magnetic contactors.
- [Solar PV & Renewable Energy](/category/solar): Commercial on-grid string inverters, hybrid inverters, solar charge controllers, and DC disconnect switches.
- [CCTV & Industrial Surveillance](/category/cctv): Network IP security cameras, PoE switches, network video recorders, and surveillance storage.

## Authorized Brands

- [ABB](/brand/abb): Circuit breakers, contactors, VFDs, and switchgear components.
- [Schneider Electric](/brand/schneider-electric): Acti9 MCBs, Compact NSX MCCBs, and automation relays.
- [Siemens](/brand/siemens): Sentron switchgear, Sirius motor starters, and power relays.
- [Hager](/brand/hager): Commercial distribution boards and modular protection.
- [Hyundai Electric](/brand/hyundai-electric): Molded case circuit breakers and vacuum breakers.
- [Growatt](/brand/growatt): Industrial grid-tied solar inverters and monitoring systems.
- [Hikvision](/brand/hikvision): Smart IP security cameras and network surveillance hardware.
- [Legrand](/brand/legrand): Cable management, industrial plugs, and distribution panels.
